entities.summary: Hiroshi Araki  is a Japanese astronomer. He works at National Astronomical Observatory of Japan's Mizusawa VLBI observatory in Ōshū, and was the Science Team sub-Leader of the MUSES-C mission. He has discovered three asteroids. With colleagues at the observatory, he has created a detailed topographic map of the Moon.
